verdict.rationale: Asana's app components let developers plug their app directly into the Asana UI, and a dedicated OpenAPI spec covers them, so in-product, native-feeling extensions exist. However, the documented surfaces are limited to tasks and rules, so building fully custom views or dashboard widgets is not evidenced. Missing for 10: custom view/page surfaces, dashboard widget extension points, UI design-system or styling guidance for native look and feel, independent hands-on corroboration.
